_doc: Fail-closed debt ratchet ceiling per architecture_debt_inference class. CI runs: python tools/architecture_debt_inference.py --check tools/debt_budget.json — debt may shrink, never grow. When you reduce a class, lower its number here in the same PR so the ratchet tightens. by_design classes are exempt. empty_evidence_ledger is tracked-only (ratchet=False): it grows with every new acceptor, so it is not hard-gated.
